raw_llm_output: For Well 15/9-F-9A, the risk of STUCK PIPE is currently CRITICAL, with a risk score of 0.8. The 95% confidence interval for this score is [0.4902, 0.9433], and 8 out of 10 matched offset wells show similar patterns. However, the detailed evidence snippets provided from top analog wells primarily describe partial mud losses [SNIPPET_SYNTH-W10_2010-01-28_MUD_LOSS] [SNIPPET_SYNTH-W22_2010-10-31_MUD_LOSS] [SNIPPET_SYNTH-W28_2011-03-18_MUD_LOSS] [SNIPPET_SYNTH-W22_2010-03-05_MUD_LOSS] [SNIPPET_SYNTH-W12_2011-01-29_MUD_LOSS] and one gas influx event [SNIPPET_SYNTH-W28_2010-11-18_KICK], rather than direct stuck pipe incidents. Specifically, Well SYNTH-W10 reported a 39.0 bbl pit drop due to partial mud loss at 1519.4m [SNIPPET_SYNTH-W10_2010-01-28_MUD_LOSS], and Well SYNTH-W22 experienced partial mud losses at 4176.7m with a 66.0 bbl pit drop [SNIPPET_SYNTH-W22_2010-10-31_MUD_LOSS] and at 1701.8m with a 132.0 bbl pit drop [SNIPPET_SYNTH-W22_2010-03-05_MUD_LOSS]. An actionable alert for STUCK PIPE is NOT YET active, but monitoring continues.
